key_insight: A coupled uncertainty-aware workflow can make ionic liquid property prediction more reliable for out-of-distribution screening and candidate ranking in solvent discovery.
engineering_relevance: This enables more trustworthy prioritization of synthesizable ionic liquids for CO2 capture by balancing solubility, viscosity, and working capacity under data-scarce conditions.
method: Train deep learning property models with uncertainty estimation for ionic liquid datasets.
Combine predicted properties with physics-based calculations and filtering to refine candidate selection.
Rank candidates by Pareto trade-offs to identify promising untapped ionic liquids for flue-gas CO2 capture.
evidence_signal: The workflow is demonstrated on novel ionic liquids for CO2 capture from flue gas, with evaluation centered on predicted properties and Pareto-optimal candidate selection.
watch_item: Performance may still depend on sparse and uneven training data, so uncertainty estimates and rankings should be validated before synthesis decisions.
paper_title: Comprehensive Workflow for Uncertainty-Aware Ionic Liquid Solvent Discovery
